rationale: None of the five gold files has a diff in the packet and the commit message is empty, so no role can be decided for any of them. The report is a two-sentence visual complaint about a hardware configuration, 'macbook pro 15 2019 with macOS 10.15.2, monitor DELL P2417H connected via HDMI. macOS settings for displays: Mirror Displays', with no log, no trace and no code named. This is the largest gold set in this batch and the one with the least evidence attached.
notes: Five gold files, no diff for any of them, no commit message, no log and no trace, so symptom_location, log_location and relation are all undeterminable and every file is unclear. Two of the five are headers, where the recorded header convention cannot be applied without a hunk. The reproducer is a third-party application on specific hardware. Decision recorded for consistency across the diff-less packets in this batch: with no hunk, a role is assigned only when the report itself localises the failure mechanism to the changed file (as in QTBUG-80945, where a sanitizer names the freeing and the using line in it, and QTBUG-81604, where the single changed file owns the operation that failed); otherwise the file is 'unclear' per rubric rule 1 and the instruction to use 'unclear' rather than guess.
